title: Downloading Landmine Agent Logs from an Endpoint

blocks.text: This article provides instructions on how to trigger the downloading of landmine agent logs from an endpoint that is actively connected to the Zscaler Deception Admin Portal. After you download the logs, you can send them to Zscaler Support to troubleshoot issues.
You cannot download logs from an endpoint for a landmine agentless installer. To learn more, see About Landmine Agent and Agentless.
To download landmine agent logs from an endpoint:

blocks.item: Go to Settings > Endpoint Settings > Agents.
In the Agents table, select an agent for which you want to download the logs.
From the Actions drop-down menu, select Trigger Logs.
After 10 minutes, a Download icon appears under the Actions column of the selected agent.
To check when the agent logs were uploaded to the Deception Admin Portal, hover over the Download icon.
The landmine agent logs from the endpoint are downloaded to your local system in a compressed (.zip) file.
